decision.summary: A transient multi-axis offset begins around index 492, with all axes dropping together (~3–4 MAD). N recovers rapidly by ~505, but E and U sustain a shallower platform-like offset through at least index 515. The return to pre-event baseline is not observed within the allowed context [450,545], and no opposing edge is confirmed for E/U; thus status is uncertain. No other temporary offsets are supported in this window.

intervals.observation: N/E/U show correlated multi-sample drop (~3–4 MAD) centered near index 495–505; N rebounds sharply by ~505, while E and U recover more gradually and remain offset through 515 without clear opposing return within allowed context
